lines.zh: 我走过土面，留下一层深蓝。
lines.en: I cross the soil and leave a deep blue layer.

lines.zh: 我的四条腿挪得很整齐。
lines.en: My four legs move in tidy order.

lines.zh: 我一踏上去，石缝就蓝了。
lines.en: One step and the seams turn blue.

lines.zh: 我专挑石头多的地方走。
lines.en: I choose the stoniest ground.

lines.zh: 我的脚步轻，颜色却压得沉。
lines.en: My steps are light; my color weighs heavy.
I keep to the wall for a stretch.

lines.zh: 我停下来，让脚边的土变色。
lines.en: I stop and let the soil change color.

lines.zh: 我每一步都把蓝压进石缝。
lines.en: Every step presses blue into the cracks.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，怕颜色被冲淡。
lines.en: I skirt the puddles so my color is not washed out.

lines.zh: 我身上像落了一层蓝砂。
lines.en: I look dusted with blue sand.
I move toward somewhere darker.
I squeeze between the stones.
I step over the blue I left yesterday.

lines.zh: 我一路往前，颜色一路加深。
lines.en: I move on, and the color deepens behind me.

lines.zh: 我蹭过墙角，那里留下一小块蓝。
lines.en: I brush a corner and leave a small blue patch.
I head for where the stone lies thin.

lines.zh: 我立着，身上的蓝在流动。
lines.en: I stand; the blue moves over me.

lines.zh: 我盯着一块断岩的断面。
lines.en: I study the broken face of a stone.

lines.zh: 暗处让我的蓝显得更深。
lines.en: The dark makes my blue look deeper.
I swell slowly and settle.
I lower my head as if considering.
I make no sound. I only glow.

lines.zh: 我在等一块颜色浅的岩面。
lines.en: I wait for a paler patch of rock.

lines.zh: 我一抖，蓝色的粉落了一地。
lines.en: I shudder and blue dust falls.

lines.zh: 我盯着地面，看来很满意。
lines.en: I stare at the ground, apparently pleased.
I turn half a circle where I stand.

lines.zh: 我把脚在石面上磨了磨。
lines.en: I rub a foot on the stone.
I lift my head toward the darker part.

lines.zh: 我像一块会呼吸的青金石。
lines.en: I am a breathing lump of lapis.
I draw myself tighter.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚从石缝里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull a foot out of the seam.
I press my color a shade deeper.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，蓝光掠过你的脸。
lines.en: I look up; blue light slides across your face.
I have not seen that blue on anyone.
I tilt my head, judging the distance.
You step back; I take half a step.

lines.zh: 我慢慢鼓起，蓝色涨满全身。
lines.en: I swell until blue fills me.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，猜它会不会变蓝。
lines.en: I watch your hand, guessing whether it will turn blue.
The stone under you is good.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只把蓝色加深。
lines.en: I make no sound; I only deepen my blue.
I look down at your feet.
You glance at me again.

lines.zh: 我把最蓝的那面转向你。
lines.en: I turn my bluest side toward you.

lines.zh: 你看得越久，我的蓝越浓。
lines.en: The longer you look, the deeper my blue.
The sheen on my surface dims.
I deflate, then slowly swell.
A little blue dust falls.
I shift a foot half a step back.
My seam has lengthened again.
I shake until the dust scatters.
A low note sounds inside me.
I guard the middle part.
It is not my time yet.
I retreat toward the wall.
I do not eat things like this.

lines.zh: 我只关心它是不是蓝的。
lines.en: I only care whether it is blue.
Wrong color. I do not want it.
You set it at my feet; I step around it.
I push it away with my heel.

lines.zh: 我要的是石头里那种蓝。
lines.en: I want the blue inside stone.
I step on it and nothing changes.

lines.zh: 我又去看你脚边那块石。
lines.en: I go back to watching the stone by your feet.
You hold it up; I keep standing.
I kick it into the ash.
I do not even sniff it.

lines.zh: 我的注意力全在石头上。
lines.en: All my attention is on the stone.
I go around it and keep walking.

lines.zh: 你把它举高，我也不抬头。
lines.en: You lift it high; I do not look up.

lines.zh: 它没有蓝，我就放在那儿。
lines.en: It has no blue, so I leave it there.

lines.zh: 我朝你脚边那块石看过去。
lines.en: I look at the stone by your feet.

lines.zh: 你碰上来，蓝光晃了一下。
lines.en: You bump into me; my blue wavers.
I am nudged half a step off.
When you pull back, your cuff is blue.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，蓝粉飘起来。
lines.en: We collide; blue dust lifts.
I turn my body aside.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩下，我把脚拔出来。
lines.en: You step down, and I pull my foot free.
A blue streak appears on your armor.
I am not offended.
I plant my feet again.
A patch of deep blue stays on the ground.
The other's blue is heavier than mine.
We walk abreast, two blue lines.

lines.zh: 我们换了一点蓝色的粉。
lines.en: We trade a little blue dust.

lines.zh: 它靠过来，我的光更深了。
lines.en: It leans in; my light deepens.

lines.zh: 我们一起把一段石面染蓝。
lines.en: Together we turn a stretch of stone blue.
We swell and settle together.

lines.zh: 它缓缓挪开，我送了两步。
lines.en: It eases off; I see it two steps.

lines.zh: 我们中间落了一层蓝粉。
lines.en: Blue dust settles between us.
It lowers its head, apparently content.
This ground is heavy with color now.
I ring it with my forelegs.
I weigh it and put it back.
I study its color.
No blue. I set it down.
I stand on it.
It slowly turns blue under my feet.
I shift it to the edge of a crack.

lines.zh: 我把它拖到岩缝口才松开。
lines.en: I drag it to the crack before letting go.
A little blue clings to it.
I let it go and walk off.

lines.zh: 你脚下这块石头我中意。
lines.en: I like the stone under you.
I have swollen full.

lines.zh: 我数着到那块青石的步数。
lines.en: I count my steps to that blue stone.

lines.zh: 我朝你脚边那块青石挪。
lines.en: I shuffle toward the bluestone by your feet.
Walking off changes nothing.
My flecks light all at once.
I have marked where you stand.
What this place lacks is blue.
I do not chase; I only come to paint.
You have a little time left.
I come on step by step, close to you.
You retreat; my pace is unchanged.
The blue grows brighter.
Plenty of stone around you.
I am not flustered at all.

lines.zh: 我沿岩壁滑到你侧后方。
lines.en: I slide along the rock face to your flank.
I eat up the gap bit by bit.
You shoot; I keep advancing.
I have picked this ground.
Two steps is all that is left.

lines.zh: 我的爆炸只改石头，不伤人。
lines.en: My blast recolours stone, not flesh.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，只是个推。
lines.en: I butt you once. Only a shove.
I press close; the blue is cold.
My seams line up with the rock.
I swell to the brim and hold.
I burst; blue turns up in the rock.

lines.zh: 你退开的半步，正好露出石面。
lines.en: Your half step back bares the stone.
Deep blue fills the flash.
This one altered a whole face.
I take one last look.
I kindle in a seam of stone.
The soil under me turns blue first.
I give one slow pulse.
The stone here is too pale.
I move toward the dark.
I settle on a broken slab.

lines.zh: 我的斑点第一次泛起蓝光。
lines.en: My spots take on blue for the first time.
I know which piece needs color.

lines.zh: 我先量了量最近的岩壁。
lines.en: I first size up the nearest wall.

lines.zh: 我等着第一只踩上石缝的脚。
lines.en: I wait for the first foot on the crack.

lines.zh: 火把我表面的蓝烤得发灰。
lines.en: Fire bakes the blue of my surface grey.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，接缝全裂开了。
lines.en: I fall, and every seam splits.

lines.zh: 水把我身上的蓝冲开一大片。
lines.en: Water washes a great patch of blue off me.
Another blast sets me off first.
An arrow buries in my seam.

lines.zh: 那光把我体内的压力抽走。
lines.en: That light draws the pressure out of me.

lines.zh: 太久没碰岩面，我的蓝快褪没了。
lines.en: Too long without rock, and my blue is fading.
The lightning scatters my blue ahead of time.

lines.zh: 我被拽走，石头一点没变。
lines.en: I am hauled away; the stone is unchanged.
